speaker: Sheldon
text: Not just the finger, the moving finger. Oh, hey, Penny. Wow. Hi.

speaker: Penny
text: Hey, Stuart. What's going on?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Nothing. I'm just getting ready to close up and head out.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, cool. Got any fun plans?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, yeah. Big night tonight. Gonna share a can of tuna with the cat.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, nice.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Not even my cat. I just feed it. Some nights it doesn't even show up.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, okay. Well, I was hoping, um, you could do me a favor. Well, I'm kind of responsible for Sheldon missing Stanley, and I really want to make it up to him. So I was hoping you could give me his phone number so they can arrange for them to meet.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sure, yeah, name it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, I'm sorry, I don't have his phone number.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, damn. Alright, thank you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait. I have his address.

speaker: Penny
text: Really? What?

speaker: Sheldon
text: But I can't give it to you.

speaker: Penny
text: Then why did you tell me you had it?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I don't know, just chatting. You're looking at a guy who could very well get stood up by a stray cat tonight.

speaker: Penny
text: I'm sorry, Stuart. Thanks anyway.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait. Maybe we can make a deal.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah?

speaker: Penny
text: What kind of deal?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I will give you the address if you go to my cousin's wedding with me.

speaker: Penny
text: You're extorting a date out of me?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I kinda have to. The cousin who's getting married is the cousin I usually go to weddings with.

speaker: Penny
text: Can I bring Leonard?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sure, what the hell. We'll tell people he's your cousin. This is Stanley's front door. We were on Stanley's curb, then we were on Stanley's walk, and now we're at Stanley's front door.

speaker: Penny
text: Deal.

speaker: Penny
text: Yep.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, Lord, you just rang Stanley's doorbell. It's Stanley's house. We're about to go in and have milk and cookies with Stan Lee.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, so yeah, I don't know if we're gonna have cookies.
